info.title: SunSynk Power View API
info.description: API specification for SunSynk Power View (Inverter monitoring system). Combined from Node-RED flows and Python client library.

base_url.description: Base URL for the Sunsynk API

post.summary: Authenticate user and obtain access token
post.description: OAuth2 token endpoint for user authentication. For new authentication flow, use /oauth/token/new with RSA encrypted password.

post.summary: Authenticate and get bearer token (new flow)
post.description: Authenticates user with credentials and returns a bearer token. Requires RSA encryption of password with public key from /anonymous/publicKey.

sign.description: MD5 hash of nonce + source + public key snippet

get.summary: Get public key for password encryption
get.description: Retrieves the RSA public key used to encrypt the password before login

schema.description: MD5 hash of nonce + source + source value

get.description: Retrieves a list of all plants associated with the account
Retrieve all inverters associated with the user account
Retrieves real-time energy flow data for a specific plant
Retrieves detailed information for a specific plant, including pricing charges, location, owner, currency, timezone, realtime energy data, and permissions.
Retrieves list of inverters associated with a specific plant

post.description: Configures the electricity pricing model for a plant. Supports three pricing types: Constant Price (type 1), Time of Use (type 2), and Live Price (type 3, UK only). Time of Use allows a maximum of 6 time slots and must have one entry starting at 00:00 and one ending at 24:00.

timeOfUse.summary: Time of Use (type 2) — up to 6 time slots

livePrice.summary: Live Price (type 3) — UK only, uses external provider rates

get.description: Retrieves real-time input data (PV) for a specific inverter
Retrieves real-time output data for a specific inverter
Retrieves real-time battery information for a specific inverter
Retrieves real-time grid information for a specific inverter
Retrieves real-time load information for a specific inverter
Retrieves real-time solar generation information for a specific inverter
Retrieves daily output statistics for a specific inverter
Retrieves the configuration settings for a specific inverter

post.description: Updates the configuration settings for a specific inverter. Accepts partial requests — only the fields included in the request body will be updated, all other settings remain unchanged.

minimal.summary: Partial settings request (only time slots and capacities)

get.description: Retrieves list of gateways associated with the account

bearerAuth.description: Bearer token obtained from /oauth/token or /oauth/token/new endpoint

volt.description: Voltage (V) — returned as a stringified number by the API (e.g. "236.6")

current.description: Current (A) — returned as a stringified number by the API (e.g. "0.9")

charges.description: Current electricity pricing charges (half-hourly slots for Live Price type 3)

products.description: Energy provider products (present for Live Price type 3)

plantPermission.description: List of permission strings for this plant

PlantInfoCharge.description: A pricing charge entry returned in the plant info response

type.description: Pricing type: 1 = Constant, 2 = Time of Use, 3 = Live Price

PlantInfoProduct.description: Energy provider product in plant info response

limitSoc.description: State of charge limit (%). Null for export.

PlantInfoRealtime.description: Real-time energy and financial data for the plant

charges.description: Pricing entries. For Constant Price (type 1): single entry covering 00:00–24:00. For Time of Use (type 2): up to 6 time slots, must start at 00:00 and end at 24:00. For Live Price (type 3, UK only): single entry with empty time ranges.

products.description: Energy provider products. Only used with Live Price (type 3, UK only).

price.description: Price per unit of energy. String for types 1 and 2, integer (0) for type 3.

type.description: Pricing type: 1 = Constant Price, 2 = Time of Use, 3 = Live Price (UK only)

startRange.description: Start time (HH:MM). Empty string for Live Price.

endRange.description: End time (HH:MM). Empty string for Live Price.

PlantIncomeProduct.description: Energy provider product configuration for Live Price (UK only)

limitSoc.description: State of charge limit (%). Null for export direction.

regionId.description: Region ID for the energy provider

InverterSettingsSet.description: Inverter settings to update. All properties are optional — only included fields will be updated. This endpoint accepts partial requests.

cap1.description: Battery capacity threshold for time slot 1 (%)

cap2.description: Battery capacity threshold for time slot 2 (%)

cap3.description: Battery capacity threshold for time slot 3 (%)

cap4.description: Battery capacity threshold for time slot 4 (%)

cap5.description: Battery capacity threshold for time slot 5 (%)

cap6.description: Battery capacity threshold for time slot 6 (%)
